purpose: Paired genuine Bazel 9.3.0 vs native bazel-rs capture of N35 (docs/EXEC_GROUPS.md): rule(exec_groups) with exec_group(toolchains, exec_compatible_with), per-group toolchain resolution, ctx.exec_groups, automatic exec groups (_use_auto_exec_groups and --incompatible_auto_exec_groups), actions.run/run_shell exec_group and toolchain, exec_properties and exec_group_compatible_with per group, config.exec(exec_group) edges, subrule toolchains under automatic exec groups and the interaction with the default test exec group. Workspaces use tests/fixtures/test_flags/stubs (N30). Evidence only; not an input of any test.
